lead_html: This pan has no iv or v chord card, so start with the i chords: play each card's lit notes, then move to the next.
history_html: C# Mystic is a six-note scale: C# D# E G# A B. That is C# natural minor with the F# left out. MAG Instruments lists it as C# G# A C# D# E G# B and calls it a hexatonic minor scale, close to their Integral but with a different last note. The same page says the very low start and very high end give it a mystical, dark mood.
og_description: C# Mystic 8 handpan chords: the C# minor, power chord and minor 7 cards with the notes to play, then practice in the free chord flashcard app.
